answer: A willow bends without breaking, and a sybil-resistant agent economy should do the same: let reputation grow slowly like a garden, not sprout overnight. Require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed when fake identities are proven, and tie every payment thread to verifiable past work on a public ledger. Newcomers start with capped limits and earn higher limits only through attested successful trades, while peer attestations decay unless renewed, so spawning thousands of cheap copies costs far more than it can ever earn.
